name: piupiu
description: PiuPiu — a child-friendly falling-word English pronunciation game with emoji faces, playful effects, spoken hints with selectable natural and child voices, star-beam rewards, eight PixiJS ambience scenes, PHaVE and PHRASE lists, themed packs, K-12 reading lists, BNC/COCA word families, Chinese/French/English UI, and PWA installation with an offline app shell.
